statement: An activation pin for a call Cell whose owning service is already at its target replica count still yields an executable move: the rebalancer observes call_activation_leases (or is enqueued directly) within the activation wait, bounded activation ADDs are exempt from at-target count-reconciliation suppression, and pin expansion stays capped by maxReplicaCount — proven by a full-calculateMoves test at target=3 with actuals already in target and the pin on node D that is red on current HEAD, so the activation dead-end is closed under the exact at-target shape the v2 harness never covered, and the data-local-call-partition-activation-v3 scenario is green.

constraints.statement: This Quest is the Option-B interim repair from solve/epics/cell-execution-ownership-vs-replica-topology.md: it exempts bounded activation ADDs from at-target suppression and makes the rebalancer reactive to activation leases; it does not split ephemeral slot ownership from durable replica topology.
RuntimeServiceRebalancerOwner and the MovePlanner remain the single placement decision owners; no parallel activation scheduler, topology cache, or lease registry is introduced.
Pin-driven activation expansion is capped by the service maxReplicaCount; the exemption never mints unbounded replicas.

Before source change acceptance, a test exercising full calculateMoves for the at-target pinned shape (target=3, actuals in target, pin on node D) must be red on current HEAD and red-on-revert for the fix.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
